basic_information.short_title: Creation of the Municipality of Nuling
basic_information.official_title: AN ACT CREATING THE MUNICIPALITY OF NULING IN THE PROVINCE OF MAGUINDANAO DEL NORTE, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
signed_by: Prof. Raby B. Angkal, Secretary General
basic_information.effectivity: 15 days after publication in the Bangsamoro Gazette or one newspaper of regional circulation

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Carves 19 barangays out of the Municipality of Sultan Kudarat to create a new municipality, Nuling, in Maguindanao del Norte — subject to a plebiscite of the voters living there.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: The Organic Law empowers the Bangsamoro Government to create, divide, merge or abolish municipalities and barangays by act of Parliament, provided the change is ratified by the people directly affected.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: If ratified, 19 barangays become a distinct and independent municipality with its own mayor, vice-mayor and eight-member council, seated at Barangay Pinaring — and entitled to its own share of national taxes.
who_will_be_affected: Residents of the 19 barangays, who vote in the plebiscite and would become residents of a new municipality
Residents of the remaining parts of Sultan Kudarat, the mother municipality
Voters, who decide whether it happens at all
Taxpayers, since ₱2.5 million a month is provided until the new municipality gets its revenue share
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: The act is in force, but the municipality acquires corporate existence only when a majority of votes cast in the plebiscite ratifies it. The plebiscite was to be held within 60 days of the act's approval.

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: You decide. This act creates the Municipality of Nuling out of 19 barangays of Sultan Kudarat — but it only becomes real if a majority of voters in those barangays approve it in a plebiscite.
in_practice: 19 barangays separate from Sultan Kudarat: Matengen, Ladia, Pigcalagan, Alamada, Raguisi, Pinaring, Damaniog, Ibotegen, Banatin, Nara, Kakar, Katidtuan, Maidapa, Kapimpilan, Bulibod, Kabuntalan, Nalinan, Panatan and Katamlangan
The seat of government is Barangay Pinaring, renamed the Poblacion
A plebiscite of qualified voters in those barangays decides it, within 60 days of approval
COMELEC conducts and supervises; the cost comes from the BARMM Contingent Fund under the FY2024 budget
The Chief Minister appoints the first mayor, vice-mayor and eight Sangguniang Bayan members
₱2,500,000 a month in financial assistance until the municipality gets its Internal Revenue Allotment share

for_specific_groups.Voters in the 19 barangays: Your vote is what creates the municipality — it does not exist until a majority of votes cast ratifies it.
for_specific_groups.Residents of the rest of Sultan Kudarat: The mother municipality loses 19 barangays if the plebiscite passes.
for_specific_groups.Incumbent Sangguniang Bayan members of S: If you actually reside in the new municipality, you serve out your remaining term in the mother municipality, not the new one.
for_specific_groups.Anyone expecting to elect the first offi: You do not. The first mayor, vice-mayor and council are appointed by the Chief Minister and hold office until the next regular election.

what_this_means_for_you.where_this_applies: Maguindanao del Norte — 19 barangays currently in Sultan Kudarat.
what_you_can_do: Check whether your barangay is among the 19 named in Section 2
Vote in the plebiscite — a majority of votes cast decides it
Ask COMELEC when the plebiscite is scheduled; the act set 60 days from approval
watch_out_for: The first set of municipal officials is appointed by the Chief Minister, not elected.
The act states no land area and no population figure for the new municipality.
Financial assistance is a floor — 'not less than' ₱2.5 million monthly — with no stated ceiling or end date beyond the IRA allocation.
The plebiscite cost falls on the FY2024 Contingent Fund, so the timetable depends on that budget.

key_terms_explained.Plebiscite: A vote of the people directly affected, required before a municipality can be created.
key_terms_explained.Poblacion: The seat of government of a municipality — here, Barangay Pinaring.
key_terms_explained.IRA / Internal Revenue Allotment: A local government's share of national taxes.
key_terms_explained.Mother municipality: The municipality the new one is carved out of — here, Sultan Kudarat.

what_this_means_for_you.status_note: Passed Jumada Al-Akhirah 07, 1445 / 20 December 2023, approved by the Chief Minister on 26 December 2023.

benefits.headline: A new municipality of 19 barangays, with ₱2.5 million a month until its tax share arrives.

direct_benefits.benefit: A local government seated in your own area rather than in a distant poblacion
direct_benefits.how_to_access: Subject to ratification in the plebiscite

direct_benefits.who_gets_it: The new Municipal Government of Nuling
direct_benefits.amount: Not less than ₱2.5 million every month until the IRA share is allocated

direct_benefits.benefit: Entitlement to a share of national taxes
direct_benefits.how_to_access: Once allocated in the revenue allotment

indirect_benefits: Services delivered from a nearer seat of government
limitations: Nothing takes effect without a favourable plebiscite.
The first officials are appointed, not elected.
No land area or population figure is stated in the act.

for_citizens: None beyond voting in the plebiscite, which is a right rather than a duty.

what_is_prohibited: The act defines no prohibited acts and creates no offences.

penalties.for_citizens: None. The act creates no offence, fine or imprisonment.

where_to_complain.first_stop: Commission on Elections (COMELEC), which conducts and supervises the plebiscite
where_to_complain.oversight: Office of the Chief Minister, which appoints the first municipal officials
where_to_complain.note: The act creates no complaints procedure of its own.

everyday_scenarios: A resident of Barangay Kakar votes in the plebiscite. If a majority of votes cast approve, Kakar leaves Sultan Kudarat and becomes part of the Municipality of Nuling.
A sitting Sangguniang Bayan member of Sultan Kudarat who lives in one of the 19 barangays finishes their term serving the mother municipality, not the new one.

A resident asks who the first mayor will be. Under Section 6 the Chief Minister appoints the mayor, vice-mayor and eight councillors immediately after ratification; they serve until the next regular election.

key_provisions: Section 1 — Policy: in the exercise of genuine autonomy and self-governance the Bangsamoro Government may create, divide, merge, abolish or substantially alter the boundaries of municipalities or barangays by act of Parliament. Units so created are entitled to their appropriate share in national taxes or the Internal Revenue Allotment, provided the change is approved by a majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite in the political units directly affected.

Section 2 — Separates 19 barangays — Matengen, Ladia, Pigcalagan, Alamada, Raguisi, Pinaring, Damaniog, Ibotegen, Banatin, Nara, Kakar, Katidtuan, Maidapa, Kapimpilan, Bulibod, Kabuntalan, Nalinan, Panatan and Katamlangan — from the Municipality of Sultan Kudarat and constitutes them into the distinct and independent Municipality of Nuling.
Section 3 — The seat of government is Barangay Pinaring, known hereafter as the Poblacion.
Section 4 — The territorial boundary follows the existing boundaries of the constituent barangays.

Section 5 — The municipality acquires corporate existence on ratification by a majority of the votes cast by qualified voters in a plebiscite in those barangays, to be held within 60 days after approval of the act. COMELEC conducts and supervises it, and the cost is taken from the BARMM Contingent Fund under the FY2024 appropriations.

Section 6 — The municipal government comprises a mayor, a vice-mayor and eight Sangguniang Bayan members appointed by the Chief Minister immediately after ratification, holding office until successors are elected at the next regular election. Incumbent elective Sangguniang Bayan members of Sultan Kudarat who actually reside in the new municipality serve out their remaining terms in the mother municipality.

Section 7 — The Bangsamoro Government shall appropriate financial assistance of not less than ₱2,500,000 every month for the administration and operation of the Municipal Government of Nuling until it is allocated its share in the revenue allotment.
Section 10 — Takes effect 15 days after publication in the Bangsamoro Gazette or one newspaper of regional circulation.

who_benefits: The new Municipal Government of Nuling
impact.allocated_budget: Not less than ₱2,500,000 per month until the municipality receives its Internal Revenue Allotment share; plebiscite costs from the BARMM Contingent Fund under FY2024.
impact.figures_note: Quoted from Sections 5 and 7. The act states no land area or population.

related_legislation.related_note: One of a cluster of municipality-creation acts passed on 20 December 2023 with BAA 54 (Datu Sinsuat Balabaran) and BAA 55 (Sheik Abas Hamza), all in Maguindanao del Norte.

implementation_status.budget_appropriated: Not less than ₱2,500,000 monthly, pending IRA allocation
implementation_status.note: Read from the enacted text as signed. The municipality's corporate existence depends on ratification in a plebiscite; whether that plebiscite was held and what it decided is not recorded here.

citizen_questions.q: Does this create the municipality straight away?
citizen_questions.a: No. It acquires corporate existence only when a majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite of the affected barangays ratifies it, to be held within 60 days of the act's approval.

Nineteen, all currently in Sultan Kudarat: Matengen, Ladia, Pigcalagan, Alamada, Raguisi, Pinaring, Damaniog, Ibotegen, Banatin, Nara, Kakar, Katidtuan, Maidapa, Kapimpilan, Bulibod, Kabuntalan, Nalinan, Panatan and Katamlangan.

citizen_questions.q: Who will be the first mayor?
citizen_questions.a: Whoever the Chief Minister appoints. The first mayor, vice-mayor and eight councillors are appointed immediately after ratification and serve until the next regular election.

citizen_questions.q: How will the new municipality pay for itself?
citizen_questions.a: The Bangsamoro Government provides not less than ₱2.5 million a month until the municipality is allocated its share of the Internal Revenue Allotment.

citizen_questions.q: Where is the seat of government?
citizen_questions.a: Barangay Pinaring, which becomes the Poblacion.
